headline: Power Grid secures Pune West transmission project via BOOT model
hook: Tenth transmission win this fiscal year
summary: State-owned Power Grid Corporation has been declared the successful bidder for the 765kV GIS Pune West transmission project. The company received the letter of intent for the build, own, operate, and transfer (BOOT) basis project. With this win, Power Grid has secured 10 tariff-based competitive bidding (TBCB) projects in FY27 so far. These projects carry a cumulative annual transmission charges of ₹7,863.63 crore. For Indian retail investors, steady order wins reinforce the company's predictable cash flows and dividend-paying profile.
why_it_matters: Steady order inflow supports Power Grid's stable dividend yield.
winners_losers: Power Grid gains / competitors miss out

headline: PTC India appoints Amol Babulal Taori as Nominee Director

summary: PTC India Limited has appointed Amol Babulal Taori as a Non-Executive Nominee Director. Taori will represent Power Grid Corporation of India Ltd. on the company's board. The appointment is effective from October 23, 2026.
why_it_matters: Routine board appointment with no immediate impact on share price.
